findings.title: Action contracts are duplicated across route layers
evidence: The normal action schemas and method dispatch conditionals are in src/routes/bot-routes.ts:41-88, while separate overlapping schemas for the same Telegram actions are in src/routes/istina-compat-routes.ts:37-74. This makes method additions require coordinated edits across route layers instead of one registry/schema extension.

findings.title: Negative-path coverage is missing for the new action boundary
evidence: The integration tests exercise successful queueing, delivery and one same-payload duplicate path in test/integration/gateway.integration.test.ts:253-365, while the unit tests in test/telegram-service.test.ts and test/retry.test.ts cover helpers only. There are no direct tests for action validation failures, missing Idempotency-Key, or conflicting payload reuse.

findings.title: The API error contract is underdocumented
evidence: README.md:24-25 identifies machine-readable errors but does not show the error JSON shape or document validation, missing-idempotency and idempotency-conflict codes. The actual response fields are implemented in src/lib/errors.ts:54-60.
